source.title: 17. Diabetes Advocacy: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026
source.citation: American Diabetes Association Professional Practice Committee for Diabetes. 17. Diabetes advocacy: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026. Diabetes Care 2026;49(Suppl. 1):S356–S357.

guideline_boundary: This two-page Standards chapter is an advocacy overview. Its statements summarize or direct readers to separate ADA advocacy statements; it is not represented as if it generated the underlying evidence.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated advocacy-statement or guideline-recommendation atom kind; source policy statements use author_conclusion or other when defensible.
extraction_limitations: The chapter provides a partial list and refers readers to separate ADA statements for detailed evidence and policy guidance.
The six cited advocacy statements were not independently read in this exact-source run.
All atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer step is represented.
protocol_version_note: The governing project file is named summary-evaluation-appraisal-protocol-v4-compact.md; its internal heading identifies Integrated Compact v3. Project precedence treats the v4-named file as authoritative.
